title: The COVID-19 Liquidity Shock (March 2020)
description: Navigate the fastest 30% drop in US market history and the historic Federal Reserve liquidity response.
lessonsLearned: Panic selling during peak volatility often locks in permanent losses right before policy interventions.
Federal Reserve liquidity facilities can establish market bottoms long before economic data recovers.
Dollar-cost averaging during extreme market drawdowns reduces average cost basis.

steps.title: All-Time Highs Before the Storm
steps.narrative: The S&P 500 closes at record highs. Reports of a novel virus in Wuhan and northern Italy begin surfacing in financial news.
steps.prompt: How do you position your $50,000 cash balance?

options.text: Keep 100% invested in index equities.
options.feedback: Equities are at all-time valuations. When the shock hits, full exposure creates immediate paper drawdowns.

options.text: Hold 50% in cash reserves and set stop losses.
options.feedback: Maintaining cash reserves gives dry powder to capitalize when valuations correct sharply.

steps.title: Black Monday and Trading Halts
steps.narrative: Global lockdowns trigger historic circuit breakers. The S&P 500 drops 12% in a single session amid severe liquidity constraints.
steps.prompt: Markets are down 25% from highs. What is your action?

options.text: Sell everything into cash to protect against further declines.
options.feedback: Selling at peak panic crystallizes deep losses right before massive central bank intervention.

options.text: Begin phased scale-in purchases of index funds.
options.feedback: Systematic buying during peak capitulation establishes positions at multi-year valuation discounts.

steps.title: The Fed Announces Unlimited Quantitative Easing
steps.narrative: The Federal Reserve pledges open-ended asset purchases and backstops corporate debt markets. Markets mark their exact cycle bottom.
steps.prompt: With unprecedented monetary stimulus announced, how do you react?

options.text: Deploy remaining cash reserves into broad market indices.
options.feedback: Following central bank liquidity injections historically produces the strongest early-cycle returns.

options.text: Wait for economic lockdown data to improve first.
options.feedback: Markets discount the future months ahead of economic headlines. Waiting means missing the steepest part of the rally.

title: The Generative AI Boom: Nvidia Guidance Shock (May 2023)
description: Experience the seminal quarterly earnings report that launched the generative artificial intelligence era.
lessonsLearned: Secular technology shifts can sustain premium valuation multiples far longer than traditional cyclical models predict.
Hardware providers often capture the earliest cash flows during major architectural platform transitions.
Trailing stop losses allow winners to run while protecting principal against sudden pullbacks.

steps.title: Pre-Earnings Setup
steps.narrative: Nvidia trades near $305 with heavy institutional interest following the launch of large language models.
steps.prompt: How do you manage position sizing into earnings?

options.text: Hold a balanced 30% allocation with defined risk limits.
options.feedback: Sizing properly manages downside gap risk while participating in positive guidance revisions.

options.text: Sell call options to capture volatility premium.
options.feedback: Short option strategies carry massive uncapped risk during historic earnings beats.

steps.title: The 50% Guidance Surprise
steps.narrative: Nvidia guides next-quarter data center revenue 50% above Wall Street estimates. Stock surges 25% overnight to $380.
steps.prompt: Nvidia gaps up to all-time highs. What is your strategy?

options.text: Let the winning position run with an escalating trailing stop.
options.feedback: Transformational technological inflections often experience multi-quarter institutional accumulation.

options.text: Immediately sell 100% of holdings to lock in one-day gain.
options.feedback: Taking quick profits on generational growth leaders frequently causes investors to miss subsequent doubling.

title: Volmageddon: The Short-Volatility Cascade (February 2018)
description: Witness how crowded financial engineering and inverse volatility products collapsed overnight.
lessonsLearned: Structural feedback loops in derivative products can trigger market dislocations disconnected from fundamentals.
Shorting volatility provides consistent small yields punctuated by catastrophic tail-risk events.
Understanding underlying liquidity mechanics is critical when trading complex exchange-traded products.

steps.title: VIX Index Spikes Over 100%
steps.narrative: A modest afternoon equity pullback forces inverse VIX products into a mandatory rebalancing squeeze, sending VIX from 17 to 37.
steps.prompt: Market volatility is surging violently. How do you respond?

options.text: Avoid leveraged inverse instruments and observe market plumbing.
options.feedback: Staying clear of toxic structural products protects capital from total wipeout.

options.text: Attempt to catch falling knives in inverse volatility notes.
options.feedback: XIV and related ETNs triggered termination clauses and lost 95% of their value in after-hours trading.

title: The Great Retail Short Squeeze (January 2021)
description: Analyze the dynamics of heavily shorted securities, retail options flow, and broker liquidity limits.
lessonsLearned: Short interest exceeding 100% of float creates extreme vulnerability to coordinated buying pressure.
Gamma squeezes driven by out-of-the-money call option purchasing force market makers to aggressively buy underlying shares.
Parabolic price moves invariably end in severe mean reversion once retail buying enthusiasm peaks.

steps.title: Parabolic Momentum Accelerates
steps.narrative: Social media trading communities drive unprecedented call option volume across heavily shorted consumer stocks.
steps.prompt: How do you evaluate risk in high-volatility momentum environments?

options.text: Recognize speculative froth and implement strict stop losses.
options.feedback: Disciplined risk management prevents devastating drawdowns when retail volume fades.

options.text: Borrow margin to buy at the peak of social media hype.
options.feedback: Using leverage at the climax of a speculative bubble frequently results in margin liquidation.

title: The 2022 Interest Rate Shock
description: Manage portfolio duration and valuation compression as the Federal Reserve hikes rates by 425 basis points in nine months.
lessonsLearned: Rising discount rates disproportionately compress multiples for high-growth, long-duration equities.
Cash and short-duration fixed income serve as essential capital preservation buffers during monetary tightening.
Rebalancing into high-quality profitable companies with pricing power outperforms unprofitable speculative growth.

steps.title: The First Rate Hike of the Cycle
steps.narrative: With CPI exceeding 7%, the Fed initiates its first 25 bps rate increase, signaling aggressive balance sheet runoff.
steps.prompt: How do you adjust your technology and growth allocations?

options.text: Rotate out of unprofitable long-duration tech into cash and value.
options.feedback: Value equities and profitable cash-generative firms proved vastly more resilient throughout 2022.

options.text: Double down on unprofitable growth equities with high P/S multiples.
options.feedback: Unprofitable growth suffered 70% to 80% valuation compression as risk-free yields climbed toward 5%.

title: Silicon Valley Bank Run & Regional Banking Crisis (March 2023)
description: Examine the unhedged bond duration crisis that led to the fastest bank run in US financial history.
lessonsLearned: Unrealized held-to-maturity bond losses become acute solvency crises during rapid deposit outflows.
Too-big-to-fail mega-cap banks often benefit from flight-to-safety deposit inflows during regional bank turmoil.
Government backstops like the Bank Term Funding Program (BTFP) contain systemic contagion.

steps.title: SVB Enters FDIC Receivership
steps.narrative: Silicon Valley Bank fails after depositors withdraw $42 billion in 24 hours. Regional bank shares plunge 30% across the board.
steps.prompt: Where do you allocate defensive capital in the financial sector?

options.text: Concentrate in Fortress Balance Sheet banks like JPMorgan Chase.
options.feedback: JPMorgan received tens of billions in flight-to-safety deposits and later acquired First Republic at favorable terms.

options.text: Aggressively buy distressed regional lenders relying on uninsured wholesale deposits.
options.feedback: Several regional banks collapsed before regulatory intervention stabilized the system.

title: Negative Crude Oil Day: -$37.63/bbl (April 2020)
description: Understand physical storage constraints and futures contract expiry mechanics when demand vanished.
lessonsLearned: Commodity futures contracts require physical settlement unless rolled prior to contract expiration.
When storage capacity reaches 100%, commodity prices can turn negative to incentivize immediate disposal.
Extreme commodity dislocations create generational buying opportunities in integrated energy producers.

steps.title: May WTI Contract Drops Below Zero
steps.narrative: Expiring May crude futures fall to -$37.63 as traders with no storage access pay buyers to take physical delivery.
steps.prompt: How do you capitalize on the unprecedented energy dislocation?

options.text: Invest in major integrated energy producers with strong balance sheets and storage capacity.
options.feedback: Major oil companies recovered strongly as OPEC production cuts and global demand normalized.

options.text: Buy front-month expiring futures contracts without delivery capabilities.
options.feedback: Holding expiring physically settled futures contracts without storage resulted in catastrophic financial liabilities.

title: The Brexit Referendum Shock (June 2016)
description: Manage political event risk and international currency volatility during Britain's vote to leave the European Union.
lessonsLearned: Betting markets and polling data can misprice binary political outcomes.
Initial geopolitical panic frequently creates short-lived buying opportunities for resilient multinational indices.
Currency devaluations provide export competitiveness tailwinds to multinational corporations.

steps.title: Leave Wins the Referendum
steps.narrative: UK votes 52% to 48% to leave the EU. British pound plunges 10% and global equities drop 3% in two sessions.
steps.prompt: Global markets are in shock. What is your trade?

options.text: Buy the dip in high-quality US and global equities.
options.feedback: The S&P 500 recovered all Brexit losses within seven trading sessions and reached new all-time highs within a month.

options.text: Liquidate long-term holdings expecting prolonged global recession.
options.feedback: Exiting on political headlines locked in unnecessary losses as markets quickly looked through the policy timeline.

title: The Christmas Eve 2018 Market Capitulation
description: Experience the culmination of the 2018 fourth-quarter bear market and the famous Powell Pivot.
lessonsLearned: Low-volume holiday trading can exacerbate selling pressure into technical capitulation bottoms.
Central bank communication shifts from hawkish to dovish trigger powerful equity reversals.
Year-end tax-loss selling often exhausts by late December, setting up strong January effect rallies.

steps.title: Worst Christmas Eve in Wall Street History
steps.narrative: The S&P 500 falls 2.7% in a shortened session, bringing the quarterly decline to nearly 20%. Sentiment reaches extreme despair.
steps.prompt: How do you handle your portfolio on Christmas Eve?

options.text: Maintain discipline and prepare to buy oversold quality names.
options.feedback: December 26 saw the Dow surge 1,086 points (record one-day point gain) kicking off a 30% rally in 2019.

options.text: Panic sell at the closing bell.
options.feedback: Selling on Christmas Eve marked the exact bottom tick of the entire 2018 correction.

title: Bitcoin Mania & CME Futures Launch (December 2017)
description: Trade the retail crypto mania of 2017 as Bitcoin climbed to $20,000 before CME futures opened two-way institutional trading.
lessonsLearned: The launch of institutional futures contracts allows institutional capital to short parabolic speculative bubbles for the first time.
Retail parabolic runs driven by Google search volume and mainstream media coverage signal late-stage exhaustion.
Taking initial principal off the table in high-beta speculative assets protects against 80%+ crypto drawdowns.

steps.title: Bitcoin Hits $19,800 Ahead of CME Launch
steps.narrative: Bitcoin reaches all-time highs as CME launches Bitcoin futures trading.
steps.prompt: What risk management protocol do you apply?

options.text: Take substantial profits and harvest original capital.
options.feedback: Bitcoin declined by 70% over the following six months. Taking profits secured massive realized returns.

options.text: Hold 100% expecting immediate continuation to $100,000.
options.feedback: Holding through late-stage parabolic exhaustion resulted in an 84% drawdown during the 2018 crypto winter.

title: Tesla's S&P 500 Inclusion Squeeze (December 2020)
description: Capitalize on index fund mandatory buying as Tesla enters the benchmark S&P 500.
lessonsLearned: Index additions of mega-cap companies force passive index funds to buy tens of billions of dollars in shares regardless of valuation.
Pre-inclusion momentum often culminates on the actual effective date (buy the rumor, sell the news).
Understanding passive ETF flows is a critical edge in modern financial markets.

steps.title: S&P Dow Jones Announces Tesla Addition
steps.narrative: Tesla will be added to the S&P 500 on December 21. Index funds must acquire over $80 billion in stock.
steps.prompt: How do you trade the mechanical index rebalancing dynamic?

options.text: Ride the front-running momentum into the inclusion date.
options.feedback: Tesla stock rallied over 50% between announcement and the December 21 inclusion date.

options.text: Short Tesla immediately based on fundamental P/E multiple.
options.feedback: Fighting structural index fund buying flows proved disastrous for short sellers in late 2020.

title: Vaccine Monday: The Great Rotation (November 2020)
description: Witness the single greatest style factor rotation in stock market history from tech to recovery cyclicals.
lessonsLearned: Macro regime shifts cause violent capital rotations between growth and value factors.
Stay-at-home beneficiaries experience multiple compression when the real economy reopens.
Cyclical value equities (energy, airlines, financials) outperform during early economic reopenings.

steps.title: Pfizer Announces 90%+ Vaccine Efficacy
steps.narrative: Pfizer and BioNTech report positive Phase 3 results. Travel and energy stocks jump 20% while Zoom and stay-at-home tech sell off.
steps.prompt: How do you rebalance your equity portfolio?

options.text: Rotate capital into cyclical value, industrials, and energy.
options.feedback: Energy and financials led market returns over the subsequent 12 months as economic activity resumed.

options.text: Stay 100% concentrated in stay-at-home software stocks.
options.feedback: Work-from-home pandemic winners peaked in late 2020 and experienced multi-year valuation de-ratings.

title: The 2018-2019 US-China Trade War
description: Navigate tariff escalations, supply chain disruptions, and retaliatory trade policy.
lessonsLearned: Companies with complex cross-border supply chains face margin pressure during trade disputes.
Headline tariff volatility creates high-frequency swings in multinational industrials and hardware tech.
Focusing on domestic revenue companies provides shelter during international tariff conflicts.

steps.title: Section 301 Tariffs Announced
steps.narrative: US proposes tariffs on $50 billion of Chinese imports. Technology and manufacturing stocks fall on retaliation fears.
steps.prompt: How do you evaluate hardware manufacturers with Chinese assembly lines?

options.text: Hedge exposure and trim vulnerable supply-chain names.
options.feedback: Hardware companies faced multiple quarters of revenue guidance cuts and inventory volatility.

options.text: Ignore geopolitical risk and maintain maximum allocation.
options.feedback: Semiconductors and hardware stocks experienced 30%+ peak-to-trough drawdowns during the trade escalation.

title: The August 2019 Yield Curve Inversion
description: Analyze the classic recession signal when the 10-year Treasury yield drops below the 2-year yield.
lessonsLearned: Yield curve inversions are reliable leading recession indicators, but with variable time lags of 12 to 24 months.
The initial inversion often sparks temporary market panic before a final late-cycle equity push.
Federal Reserve rate cuts in response to curve inversions support equity multiples in the near term.

steps.title: 2s10s Curve Flips Negative
steps.narrative: The 10-year yield falls below the 2-year yield for the first time since 2007. The Dow sinks 800 points in a single day.
steps.prompt: How do you interpret the inversion signal?

options.text: Recognize the signal is a long-term leading indicator, not an immediate sell signal.
options.feedback: Equities went on to rally 15% into early 2020 as the Fed provided liquidity cuts.

options.text: Liquidate entire equity portfolio the day the curve inverts.
options.feedback: Selling immediately caused investors to miss the entire late-2019 bull market surge.

title: The Transitory Inflation Debate (Fall 2021)
description: Trade the transition from ultra-loose pandemic stimulus to the recognition of persistent inflation.
lessonsLearned: Central bank characterization of inflation as 'transitory' can delay necessary policy tightening.
Speculative unprofitable tech stocks peak months before mega-cap indices reflect macro tightening.
Cash preservation ahead of quantitative tightening prevents severe drawdowns in growth assets.

steps.title: CPI Jumps 6.2% Year-Over-Year
steps.narrative: Inflation hits highest level in 30 years. Speculative tech stocks and ARKK components begin breaking down.
steps.prompt: What is your allocation strategy as bond yields rise?

options.text: Begin raising cash and trimming high-multiple growth equities.
options.feedback: Raising cash in late 2021 preserved capital before the brutal 2022 bear market.

options.text: Buy high-multiple software stocks trading at 30x revenue.
options.feedback: High P/S multiples experienced 70%+ declines over the following four quarters.

title: The US Debt Ceiling Standoff (May 2023)
description: Navigate Treasury cash exhaustion deadlines and sovereign credit rating uncertainty.
lessonsLearned: US debt ceiling standoffs create short-term volatility but historically resolve with a bipartisan agreement.
Treasury bill yields with maturity near the 'X-date' spike temporarily, creating short-term yield opportunities.
Post-resolution Treasury General Account (TGA) replenishment temporarily absorbs market liquidity.

steps.title: Approaching the X-Date
steps.narrative: Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen warns cash could run out by June 1. Media headlines focus on default risk.
steps.prompt: How do you position your portfolio?

options.text: Stay invested and use headline dips to accumulate index shares.
options.feedback: A deal was signed on June 3, triggering a multi-month broad market summer rally.

options.text: Sell all US equity assets expecting an unprecedented US debt default.
options.feedback: US sovereign default did not occur; exiting equities resulted in buying back at higher prices.

title: The September 2024 Fed Easing Cycle
description: Capitalize on the Federal Reserve's first rate cut in four years with a 50 bps opening move.
lessonsLearned: Rate cuts initiated during economic expansion (non-recessionary cuts) historically propel equities to new highs.
Small-cap stocks and rate-sensitive sectors benefit from reduced borrowing costs.
Lower cash yields on money market funds encourage cash rotation into risk assets.

steps.title: Fed Cuts Rates by 50 Basis Points
steps.narrative: FOMC delivers a jumbo half-point cut to recalibrate policy toward neutral as inflation cools.
steps.prompt: How do you adjust portfolio strategy as the easing cycle begins?

options.text: Maintain full equity exposure and diversify into cyclical/rate-sensitive names.
options.feedback: Markets surged to new all-time highs as liquidity conditions eased across global markets.

options.text: Keep all capital parked in 5% cash instruments.
options.feedback: Cash yields began declining immediately as banks lowered APYs on savings and CDs.

title: Apple: From $1 Trillion to $3 Trillion
description: Track the compounding power of share buybacks, services expansion, and ecosystem lock-in.
lessonsLearned: High-return-on-invested-capital (ROIC) companies with massive share repurchase programs generate enormous compound shareholder value.
Recurring services revenue warrants a higher valuation multiple than cyclical hardware sales.
Holding elite secular compounders through market cycles beats frequent market timing.

steps.title: Apple Reaches $1 Trillion Market Cap
steps.narrative: Apple becomes the first US company to cross $1 trillion. Many commentators claim upside is capped.
steps.prompt: Do you buy or hold a company with a $1 trillion valuation?

options.text: Hold for long-term compounding driven by services growth and share buybacks.
options.feedback: Apple tripled in value over the next 3.5 years, crossing $3 trillion in January 2022.

options.text: Sell completely because a trillion-dollar company cannot grow further.
options.feedback: Selling capped upside on one of the greatest corporate compounding stories in history.

title: The 2016 US Election Overnight Reversal
description: Witness the dramatic transformation from overnight limit-down futures to a massive reflation rally.
lessonsLearned: Overnight futures limit-down panics often reverse by market open as consensus reassesses policy implications.
Tax cuts and deregulation expectations trigger rapid sector rotations into financials and industrials.
Never execute market sell orders during illiquid overnight futures panics.

steps.title: Election Night Futures Plunge
steps.narrative: S&P futures drop 5% limit-down as election results roll in. By morning bell, the market opens flat and surges into the close.
steps.prompt: How do you position in response to fiscal stimulus and deregulation expectations?

options.text: Rotate capital into banks and financial institutions.
options.feedback: Financial stocks surged over 20% in the following six weeks on higher yields and deregulation optimism.

options.text: Short the market expecting political gridlock.
options.feedback: Short positions suffered immediate losses as the broad Trump reflation trade took hold.

title: Spot Bitcoin ETF Approval (January 2024)
description: Analyze institutional adoption, ETF inflows, and structural supply absorption.
lessonsLearned: Institutional ETF wrappers democratize asset access for wealth managers and retirement accounts.
Initial 'sell the news' pullbacks provide attractive entry points when backed by strong structural inflows.
Net ETF inflows create continuous price-inelastic demand for fixed-supply digital assets.

steps.title: SEC Approves 11 Spot Bitcoin ETFs
steps.narrative: Historic approval enables spot trading on US exchanges. After an initial surge, Bitcoin dips 15% as GBTC outflows hit the market.
steps.prompt: How do you treat the initial 'sell the news' dip?

options.text: Accumulate during the temporary GBTC transition dip.
options.feedback: Net ETF inflows exceeded $12 billion in the first three months, sending Bitcoin to new all-time highs above $73,000 in March.

options.text: Exit because the ETF catalyst has completed.
options.feedback: Exiting early missed the largest institutional capital inflow in exchange-traded fund history.
